item.text: Corner mode now has a fixed 160×160 composition with compact, state-derived labels; the full status and claim text remain available to assistive technology. The smoke script checks that “communities” occupies one text rectangle, that the corner canvas has no extra height, and that its key labels are visible inside the canvas. It will save `*-after.png` captures on the parent’s rerun.

item.text:
Updated the mobile hero to preserve whole words and corner mode to a true 160×160 layout. Browser smoke now checks headline wrapping, canvas bounds and visible labels, and saves after-images.

Local suite: **183 tests, 179 pass, 4 sandbox socket skips, 0 failures**. Release inventory and diff checks pass.

Prior host pass is documented; this visual iteration awaits the parent rerun. No commit, deploy, live calls or secret reads.
